description: Self-update, on the platforms that own their own updates. NOT macOS: it ships through a Homebrew cask, and a cask plus a self-updater both write to the same /Applications/cubus.app while only one knows what is really there — an app that moved itself to 0.3.0 would be reinstalled as 0.2.9 by the next `brew upgrade`, a downgrade performed by the command meant to keep you current and reported by nothing. `updater:default` asks the endpoint whether a newer signed build exists and installs it; `process:allow-restart` completes the install, without which the new version sits on disk until the user happens to quit; `dialog:allow-ask`/`allow-message` draw the question and its answer, because this app has no general modal and a two-button question is something the OS draws better than a component invented for it would.
